title: Puzzle hero
description: A calm two-column fintech hero on the powder page: a mint pill badge with a green dot and monospace caps, a large regular-weight two-line question, a soft paragraph, an ink and an outline button side by side, an arrow link and a line of small print; a wide rounded 5:3 video frame with a white 'play' pill sits on the right. On phones everything centres and stacks, buttons go full width, the frame drops below.
notes: the media slot takes a video or image (cover-cropped to 5:3); empty, it shows a soft violet placeholder
